description: Call this FIRST when the photos are on the caller's machine rather than already on the web — our renderer fetches over the network and cannot read a local path. Simplest way: read each file and pass it in `files` as base64; the reply gives you a publicUrl per photo to hand straight to create_designs, with nothing else to run. If you would rather upload the bytes yourself, pass `count` instead and you get presigned links to PUT to. Costs nothing either way.

count.description: Only when uploading the bytes yourself: how many links to mint.

files.description: The photos themselves, base64 encoded. We store them and hand back a url each. Use this unless you have a reason not to.

data.description: The image file's bytes, base64 encoded.

mimeType.description: The images' media type, e.g. image/png or image/jpeg.

name: upload_images
title: Get upload links for local photos
